flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui: App.tsx (compose route commented out), pages/ManageTemplate/form/CreateTemplateForm.tsx (template form, not a send form). ocmsadminapi: workflows/furnish/manualreview/controllers/ManualReviewController (send-email/send-sms for furnish). No ad-hoc single-send form, schedule fields or scheduled-send endpoint
note: The story asks for a single-message form: mobile number/email, subject and message, and send time (now or scheduled). That form is not on main: the compose-email/compose-sms routes are commented out (App.tsx:259-264) and folder pages/epic37 was deleted (commit 07aba128). CreateTemplateForm has Subject and message body (CreateTemplateForm.tsx:116-140) but it is a save-template form, without recipient and without send date/time, so it is not counted. No send date/time field or scheduler for ad-hoc messages was found in the UI or backend. The only send endpoints (ManualReviewController.java:300, :401) belong to furnish replies and require txnNo + noticeNo. No relevant maintenance ticket. Real email (SMTP) and SMS gateway delivery: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. The single-send form, schedule fields and input handling are not on main

steps.step: A recipient mobile number or email field is shown
steps.detail: There is no recipient field on any reachable form. The compose routes are commented out; CreateTemplateForm only has subject and template content (CreateTemplateForm.tsx:116-140). Folder ocmsadminui/src/pages/epic37 (ComposeEmail, ComposeSMS, Upload, MessageSent) was deleted from main in commit 07aba128 (15 Apr 2025, git history, not evidence of running code); the Epic37 import at App.tsx:56 and the 6 compose/upload/message-sent routes at App.tsx:259-269 are now commented out, and the Compose Email/SMS/Message Sent menu entries at LinkData.tsx:143-156 are commented out too.

steps.step: Subject and message fields are shown
steps.detail: Subject and message body exist only in the template form (CreateTemplateForm.tsx:116-140) for creating/editing templates; it is not an ad-hoc send form, and the Preview/test button in EditTemplateForm.tsx:43-70 is commented out. Not claimed because the template mechanism is not what the story names.

steps.step: Send now or scheduled date and time fields are shown
steps.detail: No send date/time field exists in the UI or backend for ad-hoc messages. No ad-hoc endpoint in ocmsadminapi or ocmsadminprivateapi (grep adhoc/ad-hoc, compose, message-sent, enotification-send, scheduled send: zero hits in src; the only send-email/send-sms are in ManualReviewController.java:300 and :401, for furnish replies that require txnNo and noticeNo, not ad-hoc).

steps.step: The officer's input is validated and accepted by the system
steps.detail: No ad-hoc endpoint accepts this input. send-email in ManualReviewController.java:300 validates recipient/subject (:316-322) but requires the furnish txnNo and noticeNo, so it cannot be used for free-form messages. No ad-hoc endpoint in ocmsadminapi or ocmsadminprivateapi (grep adhoc/ad-hoc, compose, message-sent, enotification-send, scheduled send: zero hits in src; the only send-email/send-sms are in ManualReviewController.java:300 and :401, for furnish replies that require txnNo and noticeNo, not ad-hoc).

steps.step: The SMS or email is sent as entered, now or scheduled
steps.detail: There is no immediate or scheduled sending for ad-hoc messages. The existing senders (ManualReviewController.java:300 send-email, :401 send-sms) are specific to furnish replies and send immediately without scheduling. Real delivery through SMTP/gateway: cannot verify from repo.
